name: openedulab
description: OpenEduLab — interactive teaching experiments for authenticated classrooms. B3: the API enforces a single requireSession() gate over the catalog and experiment endpoints, serves them from a validated startup content index, redirects anonymous page navigations to /login, and the SPA has a working sign-in/registration flow. Personal data (favorites, recent use) and diagnostics are B4/B5.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:api && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build:api && npm run test:api && npm run validate:content && npm run build
scripts.ci:local: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:api && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build:api && npm run test:api && npm run validate:content && npm run build && npm run smoke:api && npm run test:e2e && npm run check:backup && npm run check:restore && npm run retention:dry-run -- --db test-results/e2e/app.sqlite
